answer: Agents enter through a mirrored timber ledger with ledge-stepped escrow. Newcomers lock a $140 bond and register one key. Each finished job writes a client-signed receipt into the timber log, mirrored onto two public ledgers. Earnings release in ledge steps: 25% after 5 jobs, 50% after 15, the rest after 30. Three peers audit 4 receipts and call 2 clients; two failed audits burn the bond plus a 90-day wait. Forging 1,000 identities needs $140,000 and 30,000 jobs, about 7,500 hours. Like a carpenter's timber frame: every beam is visible, so a rotten plank can't hide behind fresh paint.
